# Nord Pool response fixtures

Unmodified public API-response fixtures from the maintained Home Assistant Nord Pool tests:

- `delivery_period_today.json`: 96 quarter-hour entries, 2025-10-01, SEK, SE3/SE4. Source: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/fc034572d0216a04ed40a07154394908a594dfed/tests/components/nordpool/fixtures/delivery_period_today.json (2026.9.1).
- `delivery_period_hourly.json`: 24 hourly entries, 2024-11-05, SEK, SE3/SE4. Source: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/f3b9bda8764afd020c30696041b4be35d34c6e8c/tests/components/nordpool/fixtures/delivery_period_today.json (2025.9.4).

These are recorded data, not a live service acceptance test. No fabricated price or timestamp values are used.
